title: Seller Refund Terms for the Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
## Terms in force

**Status.** A seller refund can be made while the Pocketwire Business Profile status is active, under review or suspended, so that a suspended seller can still make buyers whole. The status is read from the profile record.

**Refund window.** A refund is made only within the refund window: the refund is made no later than the tier's refund window in calendar days after the sale date. The window is counted in calendar days from the sale date, the day after the sale being day 1, and a refund on the last day qualifies. The sale date is the date recorded on the sale being refunded.

**Amount.** The refunds on one sale together may not exceed its amount, and a sale on which a claim was decided for the buyer can no longer be refunded.

**Source of funds.** A refund can be taken from funds on hold for that same sale, and it can take the business balance negative.

## Retired clause

The clause "On tiers whose refund terms credit the percentage part back, the percentage part of the sale's transaction fee is credited back in proportion to the refunded share of the sale, rounded to the cent (half up); the fixed part and any cross-border fee are never credited back, and on other tiers no fee is credited back" is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current refund fee credit basis.

## Boundary days (with a refund window of 180 days)

| Refund dated | Day of the window | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|
| the sale date itself | — | yes |
| the day after the sale | day 1 | yes |
| 180 calendar days after the sale date | day 180, the last day | yes |
| 181 calendar days after the sale date | day 181 | no |

**Amount check (hypothetical sale).** On a sale of USD 80.00 already refunded USD 50.00, a further refund of up to USD 30.00 keeps the refunds within the sale amount.

superseded_clauses: On tiers whose fee_refund_pct_portion_on_refund is true, the percentage part of the sale's transaction fee is credited back in proportion to the refunded share of the sale, rounded to the cent (half up); the fixed part and any cross_border_fee are never credited back, and on other tiers no fee is credited back.
